brief:
Israeli authorities are preparing to allow cement, steel, and pipes into Gaza for sewage infrastructure repairs, Channel 12 reported. The decision comes under American pressure and amid concerns over weather deterioration, despite Hamas remaining armed.

The materials classified as dual-use — capable of civilian and military application — have long been restricted at Gaza's borders. Israel has faced international pressure to ease restrictions on reconstruction materials as the territory faces mounting infrastructure challenges.

title: Israel prepares to allow dual-use materials into Gaza for sewage repairs
